verses.arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.english: The Hour has drawn near and the moon is split.
verses.transliteration_html: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru
verses.transliteration_text: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
verses.english: If they see a sign, they turn away, and say, ‘An incessant magic!’
verses.transliteration_html: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun
verses.transliteration_text: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.english: They denied and followed their own desires, and every matter has a setting [appropriate to it].
verses.transliteration_html: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun
verses.transliteration_text: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.english: There have already come to them reports containing admonishment,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun

verses.arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.english: [and representing] far-reaching wisdom; but warnings are of no avail!
verses.transliteration_html: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru
verses.transliteration_text: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
verses.english: So turn away from them! The day when the Caller calls to a dire thing,
verses.transliteration_html: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin
verses.transliteration_text: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin

verses.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
verses.english: they will emerge from the graves as if they were scattered locusts with a humbled look [in their eyes],
verses.transliteration_html: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun
verses.transliteration_text: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun

verses.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
verses.english: scrambling toward the summoner. The faithless will say, ‘This is a hard day!’
verses.transliteration_html: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun
verses.transliteration_text: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun

verses.arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.english: The people of Noah impugned before them. So they impugned Our servant and said, ‘A crazy man,’ and he was reviled.
verses.transliteration_html: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira
verses.transliteration_text: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.english: Thereat he invoked his Lord, [saying,] ‘I have been overcome, so help [me].’
verses.transliteration_html: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir
verses.transliteration_text: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir

verses.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
verses.english: Then We opened the gates of the sky with pouring waters,
verses.transliteration_html: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin
verses.transliteration_text: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin

verses.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.english: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and the waters met for a preordained purpose.
verses.transliteration_html: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira
verses.transliteration_text: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira

verses.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
verses.english: We bore him on a vessel made of planks and nails,
verses.transliteration_html: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin
verses.transliteration_text: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin

verses.arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.english: which sailed [over the flood waters] in Our sight, as a retribution for him who was met with disbelief.
verses.transliteration_html: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira
verses.transliteration_text: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira

verses.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We have left it as a sign; so is there anyone who will be admonished?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.english: So how were My punishment and warnings?
verses.transliteration_html: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.english: [The people of] ‘Ad impugned [their apostle]. So how were My punishment and warnings?
verses.transliteration_html: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
verses.english: Indeed We unleashed upon them an icy gale on an incessantly ill-fated day,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin

verses.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
verses.english: knocking down people as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
verses.transliteration_html: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin
verses.transliteration_text: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.english: So how were My punishment and warnings?!
verses.transliteration_html: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.english: [The people of] Thamud denied the warnings,
verses.transliteration_html: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.english: and they said, ‘Are we to follow a lone human from ourselves?! Indeed then we would be in error and madness.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin
verses.transliteration_text: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin

verses.arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
verses.english: ‘Has the Reminder been cast upon him from among us? No, he is a self-conceited liar.’
verses.transliteration_html: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun
verses.transliteration_text: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun

verses.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.english: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is a self-conceited liar.
verses.transliteration_html: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru
verses.transliteration_text: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru

verses.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.english: We are sending the She-camel as a trial for them; so watch them and be steadfast.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir
verses.transliteration_text: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir

verses.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
verses.english: Inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each of them showing up at his turn.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun
verses.transliteration_text: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun

verses.arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.english: But they called their companion, and he took [a knife] and hamstrung [her].
verses.transliteration_html: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara
verses.transliteration_text: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.english: So how were My punishment and My warnings?!
verses.transliteration_html: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.english: We sent against them a single Cry, and they became like the dry sticks of a corral builder.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri
verses.transliteration_text: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.english: And the people of Lot denied the warnings.
verses.transliteration_html: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
verses.english: We unleashed upon them a rain of stones, excepting the family of Lot, whom We delivered at dawn
verses.transliteration_html: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin

verses.arabic: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.english: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
verses.transliteration_html: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara
verses.transliteration_text: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.english: He had already warned them of Our punishment, but they disputed the warnings.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.english: They even solicited of him his guests, whereat We blotted out their eyes, [saying,] ‘Taste My punishment and My warnings!’
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.english: Early at dawn there visited them an abiding punishment:
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.english: ‘Taste My punishment and warnings!’
verses.transliteration_html: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.transliteration_text: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.english: Certainly the warnings did come to Pharaoh’s clan
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru

verses.arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.english: who denied all of Our signs. So We seized them with the seizing of One [who is] all-mighty, Omnipotent.
verses.transliteration_html: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin
verses.transliteration_text: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin

verses.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.english: Are your faithless better than those? Have you [been granted] [some sort of] immunity in the scriptures?
verses.transliteration_html: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi
verses.transliteration_text: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
verses.english: Do they say, ‘We are a confederate league’?
verses.transliteration_html: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun
verses.transliteration_text: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun

verses.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.english: The league will be routed and turn its back [to flee].
verses.transliteration_html: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura
verses.transliteration_text: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.english: Indeed, the Hour is their tryst; and the Hour will be most calamitous and bitter.
verses.transliteration_html: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru
verses.transliteration_text: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed the guilty are steeped in error and madness.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.english: The day when they are dragged on their faces into the Fire, [it will be said to them,] ‘Taste the touch of hell!’
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed We have created everything in a measure,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.english: and Our command is but a single [word], like the twinkling of an eye.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari
verses.transliteration_text: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We have destroyed your likes. So is there anyone who will be admonished?
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.english: Everything they have done is in the books,
verses.transliteration_html: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi
verses.transliteration_text: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.english: and everything big and small is committed to writing.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun
verses.transliteration_text: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and streams,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin

verses.arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.english: in the abode of truthfulness with an omnipotent King.
verses.transliteration_html: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin
verses.transliteration_text: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin
